description: Recommend the best software tools for a described need. Unlike search_tools (raw retrieval), this ranks candidates by fit, applies hard constraints (budget, pricing, category), and returns a justified, sourced shortlist with fit scores, caveats, verified starting prices, and next steps. Use this when a user asks 'what should I use for X'.

exclude.description: Tool slugs to exclude from the shortlist

max_monthly_budget.description: Hard cap on the per-tool monthly price in USD

need.description: Natural-language need, e.g. 'simple CRM for a 6-person agency that syncs with Gmail'

team_size.description: Number of people who will use the tool

name: recommend_tools
